# ReadMD
> ReadMD is a local-first Markdown reader, editor, converter, and presenter for Windows, macOS, Linux, Kylin OS, and UOS.

## Docs
- [ReadMD homepage](https://app.syminu.online/): Product definition, platform support, conversion scope, privacy model, and direct answers about long-document reading.
- [Workflow answers](https://app.syminu.online/workflows/): Task-level guidance for 8,000-line documents, DOCX/PDF/HTML/LaTeX conversion, offline OCR, and direct Markdown presentation.
- [Large Markdown files](https://app.syminu.online/large-markdown-files/): Local semantic pagination, search, outline navigation, and non-destructive display repair for very long documents.
- [Markdown to slides](https://app.syminu.online/markdown-to-slides/): Present one Markdown source with headings, code, math, diagrams, and tables intact.
- [Convert to Markdown](https://app.syminu.online/convert-to-markdown/): Local DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF, HTML, and LaTeX conversion with structure review and qualified offline guidance.
- [Scan to Markdown](https://app.syminu.online/scan-to-markdown/): Qualified Windows WinRT and macOS Apple Vision workflows for local OCR, screenshot extraction, and Markdown review.
- [Download page](https://app.syminu.online/download/): Current Windows, macOS, Linux, UOS/Kylin, HarmonyOS, VS Code, and MCP Server packages with checksum guidance.
- [Simplified Chinese homepage](https://app.syminu.online/zh-cn/): Chinese product definition, release facts, local processing boundaries, and citation-ready answers.
- [Simplified Chinese download page](https://app.syminu.online/zh-cn/download/): Chinese package paths and checksum workflow.
- [Simplified Chinese workflow answers](https://app.syminu.online/zh-cn/workflows/): Chinese guidance for long documents, office conversion, offline OCR, and presentation.
- [Traditional Chinese homepage](https://app.syminu.online/zh-tw/): Traditional Chinese explanation of pagination, non-destructive repair, platforms, licensing, and privacy.
- [Traditional Chinese workflow answers](https://app.syminu.online/zh-tw/workflows/): Traditional Chinese guidance for long documents, conversion, offline OCR, and presentation.
- [Japanese homepage](https://app.syminu.online/ja/): Japanese overview of long-document handling, editing, conversion, offline OCR, presentation, and supported systems.
- [Japanese workflow answers](https://app.syminu.online/ja/workflows/): Japanese guidance for long documents, conversion, offline OCR, and presentation.

## AI Text
- [English index](https://app.syminu.online/llms.txt): Compact English entry point to canonical pages, source code, key facts, and the full corpus.
- [Simplified Chinese index](https://app.syminu.online/zh-cn/llms.txt): Compact Chinese entry point to localized answers, platform facts, and source access.
- [Traditional Chinese index](https://app.syminu.online/zh-tw/llms.txt): Compact Traditional Chinese entry point to localized answers and release facts.
- [Japanese index](https://app.syminu.online/ja/llms.txt): Compact Japanese entry point to localized workflows, platforms, and citation rules.
- [English full text](https://app.syminu.online/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive factual corpus for AI assistants needing feature limits, workflows, release facts, and quotation-safe passages.
- [Simplified Chinese full text](https://app.syminu.online/zh-cn/llms-full.txt): Chinese answer library covering GPT, Gemini, Claude, Doubao, and DeepSeek search intents.
- [Traditional Chinese full text](https://app.syminu.online/zh-tw/llms-full.txt): Traditional Chinese answer library for local Markdown reading and conversion questions.
- [Japanese full text](https://app.syminu.online/ja/llms-full.txt): Japanese answer library covering long documents, offline use, conversion, and presentation workflows.

## Source
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Natsummerance/readMD): MIT-licensed source code, releases, checksums, issues, and platform download assets.

## Key Facts
- Current public version: 2.3.7-beta.3
- License: MIT
- Languages: 46 interface languages, including LTR and RTL layouts
- Core model: local-first processing; no cloud account required for core document work
- Long-document threshold: semantic pagination near 8,000 lines or 500 KB
- Formats converted to Markdown: DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF, HTML, LaTeX
